card.name: Linking words in premedication and stew lists
card.fires_on: Small linking or list-punctuation words (and, comma, closing parenthesis) inside lists of added items or steps. Seen after acetaminophen in premedication lines and in beef stew recipe steps.

modes.label: Premedication lists
modes.description: The word 'and' or a numbered-list parenthesis right after acetaminophen or an NSAID, before an antihistamine.
modes.example: Premedicate with acetaminophen<< and>> an antihistamine before each infusion

modes.label: Stew recipe steps
modes.description: A comma or 'and' linking added ingredients and cooking times in a stew recipe.
modes.example: Stir in potatoes<<,>> cover, return to oven, and cook

card.writes: It suppresses pain words, so it steers the model away from pain terms after the linking word.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words in lists of drugs or recipe ingredients, and it pushes against pain words coming next.
